positive_snippets: Rooms were clean and spacious. But service was very slow. Rooms were not ready by the checkin time. Towel and toiletries were not provided in all the rooms. Hot water was not provided in the washroom in some rooms despite multiple complains. But food was good
Had a wonderful stay! The rooms were spotless, beautifully maintained, and very comfortable. The staff was polite and always ready to help. Highly recommended.

The staff also had zero manners; we were pestered for tips from the moment we arrived. Avoid at all costs if you’re traveling with family. They staff have no member how to talk with their guests. It's very worst hotel for stay. It's look like an oyo without branding.
